MOLECULAR GENETICS LABORATORY
DNA EXTRACTION AND STORAGE NOTIFICATION

Patient: [redacted name]
MRN: [redacted ID]

Specimen ID: [redacted ID]
Collection Date: [redacted]
Report Date: [redacted]

SPECIMEN TYPE
Peripheral blood (EDTA)

TEST PERFORMED
DNA extraction and storage

RESULTS

DNA EXTRACTION - PATIENT SAMPLE
Specimen: Whole blood (3ml EDTA)
Extraction method: QIAamp DNA Blood Mini Kit
DNA concentration: 125 ng/μL
A260/A280 ratio: 1.85
Total yield: 25 μg
Storage: -80°C freezer, Rack [redacted], Position [redacted]
Result: DNA successfully extracted and stored

DNA EXTRACTION - ADDITIONAL SAMPLE
Individual: [redacted name] (relationship to patient not specified)
Specimen ID: [redacted ID]
Specimen: Whole blood (3ml EDTA)
Extraction method: QIAamp DNA Blood Mini Kit
DNA concentration: 98 ng/μL
A260/A280 ratio: 1.82
Total yield: 19.6 μg
Storage: -80°C freezer, Rack [redacted], Position [redacted]
Result: DNA successfully extracted and stored

NOTES
- DNA samples are available for future genetic testing as clinically indicated
- Karyotype analysis has been ordered separately on these specimens
- Karyotype results will be reported under separate cover when complete
- Please contact the laboratory at [redacted] to request specific DNA-based tests

DISCLAIMER
This report documents DNA extraction and storage only. No genetic analysis has been performed at this time. The relationship between the two individuals tested has not been verified by this laboratory. Clinical correlation and appropriate genetic counseling are recommended before proceeding with genetic testing.

SAMPLE IDENTIFICATION
Sample identity is based on information provided at the time of specimen collection. This laboratory has not performed independent identity verification.

Authorized by: [redacted name], PhD, FACMG
Laboratory Director
